Stelac Advisory Services Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 142.95% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stelac Advisory Services Llc bought 6,101 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 10,369 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.74M, up from 4,268 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stelac Advisory Services Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $944.84 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.05% or $1.99 during the last trading session, reaching $192.23. About 9.60 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Pictet Bank & Trust Ltd decreased its stake in Nike Inc (NKE) by 15.2% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 28,984 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.93 million, down from 34,178 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pictet Bank & Trust Ltd who had been investing in Nike Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $117.88B market cap company. It has outperformed by 25.44% the S&P500.
Analysts await NIKE, Inc. (NYSE:NKE) to report earnings on June, 28 after the close. They expect $0.64 earnings per share, up 6.67% or $0.04 from last year’s $0.6 per share. NKE’s profit will be $1.03B for 28.57 P/E if the $0.64 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.68 actual earnings per share reported by NIKE, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -5.88% negative EPS growth.
